verdict.rationale: Mollie documents Advanced access tokens that can be scoped to a specific mode or profile, with permissions grouped by business area and API. Its official MCP server, aimed at agent use, requires such a token with a mandatory profile.read scope and optional per-API scopes that enable each tool. That is least-privilege credentialing aimed directly at agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of token expiry, rotation and revocation and of read-versus-write granularity per resource.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
